scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome.
Honorable Knight,
would you like to rent
a Peco Peco? The rental
fee is {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临。
尊敬的骑士，
您想租一只大嘴鸟吗？
租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but these
Peco Pecos are only
available for Knights
and Lord Knights.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
很抱歉，
这些大嘴鸟只提供给
骑士和骑士领主使用。

scripts.text: Rent Peco Peco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鸟

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
Are you...
bankrupt?
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您的Zeny不足。
您该不会...破产了吧？

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I'm sorry, but you're
not eligible for this
service. Please go learn
the Peco Peco Ride skill first.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
很抱歉，您不符合
使用本服务的条件。
请先学习骑乘术。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You're already
mounted on a
Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您现在已经骑在
大嘴鸟上了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
请先下马。
（请移除您的付费坐骑）

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
I see.
Well then,
have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
明白了。
那么，祝您
度过愉快的一天。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Crusader.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临，十字军。
我们为您准备了
特别的大嘴鸟。
租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Welcome, Paladin.
We have a special
Peco Peco prepared
for you. To rent one
will cost {0} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
欢迎光临，圣殿十字军。
我们为您准备了
特别的大嘴鸟。
租金是{0} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
What can I do for you?
Please be aware that
this Peco Peco rental
service is strictly for
Crusaders and Paladins.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
请问有什么可以帮您？
请注意，
本大嘴鸟租赁服务
仅限十字军和圣殿十字军使用。

scripts.text: Rent a PecoPeco
scripts.translation: 租大嘴鸟

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You do not
have enough zeny.
If you would like
a Peco Peco please
bring {0} zeny...
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您的Zeny不足。
如果您想要大嘴鸟，
请准备{0} Zeny...

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You must first learn
to ride a PecoPeco before
I can rent one to you.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
在您学会骑乘大嘴鸟之前，
我无法将大嘴鸟租给您。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
You are already
mounted on a Peco Peco.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
您现在已经骑在
大嘴鸟上了。

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
Please remove your cash mount.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
请先下马。
（请移除您的付费坐骑）

scripts.text:
[Peco Peco Breeder]
See you around.
scripts.translation:
[大嘴鸟饲养员]
回头见。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...
在您解除战狼之前，
是无法租猎鹰的！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Do you need a Falcon?
You can rent your own
trusty bird of prey for a
fee of just {0} zeny~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
您需要猎鹰吗？
只需{0} Zeny，
您就可以租到您专属的
可靠猛禽~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Young fool!
Falcons can only
be used by Hunters
and Snipers, capish?
...Heh heh, jealous?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
无知的年轻人！
猎鹰只能由
猎人和神射手使用，懂吗？
...嘿嘿，羡慕吗？

scripts.text: Rent Falcon
scripts.translation: 租猎鹰

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You can't rent a Falcon
until you dismiss your warg first!
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...
在您解除战狼之前，
是无法租猎鹰的！

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
What is this?
You don't have
enough zeny?!
You better start
hunting money
instead of monsters~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
这是什么？
您的Zeny不足？！
您还是先去
赚点钱，
别光顾着打怪了~

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Gosh~
Go learn how to
manage a Falcon
first! I can't rent one
to you if you can't
handle it, you know.
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
哎呀~
您得先学会
如何驾驭猎鹰！
如果您无法驾驭它，
我是不能租给您的，您知道的。

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
Um...
You already have
a Falcon. It's right
there, can't you see it?
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
嗯...
您已经有一只猎鹰了。
它就在您身边，
您没看见吗？

scripts.text:
[Falcon Breeder]
W-wait, where're
you goin'? These
Falcons are top notch,
I guarantee it! C'mon, yo~
scripts.translation:
[猎鹰饲养员]
等...等等，
您要去哪？
我的猎鹰都是
顶尖的，
我向您保证！
来吧，您~
